canonical(sort_keys=True) sorts nested schema properties; status moves from first in source to last on wire. Recorded C++ grammar follows wire order faithfully. Canonical schema hash alone cannot distinguish ordering effects.
Prompt omits the full strict abstention shape and some case-specific required representation rules. Single calculation field cannot trace multiple requested calculations separately.

Capacity asks whether a ratio can be calculated. A supported answered No fails only the hardcoded expected-status requirement; the actual positive claim remains false and rejected. Clarify the future fictional question prospectively; retain both old failures.
Flat enums do not encode unit/currency/scale compatibility; validator rejects invalid tuples. Grammar membership is not factual validity.
Mechanics do not establish final-answer meaning, quantity-role association, formula meaning or citation entailment. Manual review remains required.
